extracted.name: My homemade mini Pizza 🍕
extracted.description: Healthy and deliciuos snacks for my family.. easy and simple 😊
instruction_lines: Mix warm milk, sugar and yeast Let it rest and become active
Add eggs and milk powder.. mix well
Add salt and flour in batch. Brush with butter in each addition.. Knead (hand or machine). Until texture become soft and smooth.
Let it rest and double size for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, punch the air out.. roll flat on the table and cut as desired shape.
Add sauce, veggies of your choice. Add mozarella cheese and Bake.
